  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "PREREQ-AC-IDS",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "Requirements fields contain REQ identifiers, with AC references supplied by the explicit Test Ownership table. All referenced AC-001 through AC-020 exist in acceptance-tests.md; all 162 TEST/AC ownership pairs resolve."
    },
    {
      "id": "BLOCKERS-FORMAT",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "blockers_format_valid=true. Every task has a Blockers section containing None or comma-separated T-NNN identifiers. T-001 declares None; T-008 declares T-006, T-007. No ranges or prose dependencies occur."
    },
    {
      "id": "REQ-COVERAGE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "Every requirement REQ-001 through REQ-020 appears in task Requirements fields: T-001 covers 001/002/003/005/006; T-002 covers 004/007/008; T-003 through T-007 cover 011 through 019; T-008 covers 004/006/009/010/020."
    },
    {
      "id": "AC-COVERAGE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "tasks.md Test Ownership explicitly maps all AC-001 through AC-020 and all TEST-001 through TEST-162 to tasks. Task Done When criteria require their assigned acceptance cases to pass."
    },
    {
      "id": "ORPHAN-TASK",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Each task T-001 through T-008 has a nonempty Requirements field containing existing REQ-NNN identifiers; no pseudo-requirement exception is needed."
    },
    {
      "id": "ORPHAN-TEST",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "No task is exclusively test-file work. All eight tasks nevertheless have explicit AC-linked test ownership, including T-007 evaluation through TEST-127/AC-019 and T-008 rollout verification through AC-004/006/009/010/020."
    },
    {
      "id": "INITIAL-STATE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "All eight tasks declare Approval: Draft and Status: Planned, valid for pre-implementation attempt 1 round 3. The lifecycle section reserves subsequent approval-field changes until after task review."
    },
    {
      "id": "RISK-WORKFLOW-FORMAT",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "T-001 through T-006 declare high/tdd; T-007 and T-008 declare medium/acceptance-first. Every task supplies both fields and matches the risk matrix, consistent with workflow_match_precheck=PASS."
    },
    {
      "id": "NO-DUPLICATE-AC",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "The Test Ownership table assigns each of 162 TEST identifiers exactly once. Shared ACs are differentiated by named branches and task scopes: planner versus workflow/hosted rollout, and model core versus protected transport, installed entries and adoption evaluation. Requirements fields do not duplicate undifferentiated primary AC targets."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEPENDENCY-COMPLETE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "All blocker targets exist among dependency-graph.json nodes T-001 through T-008. Its eight edges match the task Blockers sections, including T-006 waiting for T-003 and T-008 joining T-006/T-007."
    },
    {
      "id": "DEPENDENCY-CYCLE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Critical",
      "finding": "BLOCKERS-FORMAT and DEPENDENCY-COMPLETE passed. Following every from-to dependency terminates at T-001; the graph has no cycle. T-001, T-002, T-003, T-004, T-005, T-006, T-007, T-008 is a valid execution order."
    },
    {
      "id": "SINGLE-CONCERN",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Scopes separate planner/evidence contracts (T-001), workflow integration (T-002), model policy core (T-003), protected transport (T-004), installed entry integration (T-005), freshness maintenance (T-006), controlled adoption (T-007), and verified release delivery (T-008). Associated tests, catalog registration and documentation support these concerns; explicit exclusions prevent transport, maintenance and adoption algorithms from being recombined."
    },
    {
      "id": "OBSERVABLE-DONE",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "Done When criteria name inspectable test outcomes, contract rejection behavior, inventory parity, runtime identity evidence, fixed evaluation results, documentation checks or immutable release records. T-001/T-003 name concrete commands; all tasks require task-local evidence and implementation reports, whose paths are defined in Lifecycle and authorization. T-007 specifies two repetitions and frozen rubric outcomes; T-008 specifies exact-tested revision and tag evidence. precheck-result.json frozen_artifact_done_when is empty, so there are no flagged items requiring individual adjudication. Outcomes belong in non-frozen addenda; no Done When item requires editing frozen specification or traceability bodies."
    },
    {
      "id": "TRACEABILITY-SYNC",
      "status": "PASS",
      "severity": "Major",
      "finding": "traceability.md includes every task T-001 through T-008 and only existing requirements REQ-001 through REQ-020. Every requirement row cites a resolving canonical layer anchor: infra-spec.md#deployment-topology, security-spec.md#trust-boundaries or ux-spec.md#scope-and-user-journeys. Frontend N/A coverage cites frontend-spec.md#technology-stack; all four layer documents were read from the reserved manifest."
    }
